preconditions.expression: 1 <= int(N) <= 2000 and 1 <= int(M) <= 200 and int(M) <= int(N)
preconditions.description: Input dimensions N and M satisfy 1 ≤ N ≤ 2000, 1 ≤ M ≤ 200, and M ≤ N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == int(M) for line in first_map_lines) and all(len(line) == int(N) for line in second_map_lines)
preconditions.description: First map has N lines of length M, and second map has M lines of length N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for line in first_map_lines for c in line) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for line in second_map_lines for c in line)
preconditions.description: All characters in both maps are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map_lines[i-1][j:j+int(M)] == second_map_lines[j-1][i-1:i-1+int(M)] for i in range(1, int(N)-int(M)+2) for j in range(1, int(N)-int(M)+2) if first_map_lines[i-1][j:j+int(M)] == second_map_lines[j-1][i-1:i-1+int(M)])
postconditions.description: The output (i, j) identifies a valid M×M section in the first map (starting at row i) that matches the M×M section in the second map (starting at column j).

postconditions.expression: 1 <= int(i) <= int(N) - int(M) + 1 and 1 <= int(j) <= int(N) - int(M) + 1
postconditions.description: The output (i, j) is within valid bounds for the M×M section in both maps.
